gen-gf-warnes-gf-noto-sans-inscriptional: Big open eyes on every e and a make this body text feel unhurried. Noto Sans Inscriptional Parthian sits beneath Warnes, whose tapered ink strokes keep a flat, unmodulated weight and stretched, spacious tracking.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-noto-sans-jp: Noto Sans JP brings a very high x-height and curves that sweep open instead of curling shut. And Warnes, cut like sign-shop vinyl at a single line width, gives it a loud, stretched-out partner.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-noto-sans-khmer: Warnes draws spacious, stretched letters from ink strokes that taper out before they touch, with no hairlines anywhere. But Noto Sans Khmer does the quiet work, with generous chisel-notch openings and small letters nearly capital-sized.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-noto-sans-khudawadi: Expressive Warnes lays fine-rope strokes of constant width. Noto Sans Khudawadi keeps capitals close to lowercase height and leaves its rounds unsealed, like an unlatched hook, so the sans-serif text stays friendly.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-noto-sans-lao: Spaghetti-like strokes of uniform width, tapering out before they touch, give Warnes its stretched, bold look. Noto Sans Lao feels crisp and contemporary beside it, with mouths that stay open and an x-height pushed high.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-noto-sans-limbu: Warnes stretches out bold, expressive letters whose curves match the weight of their straight stems. Noto Sans Limbu joins in with gaping curves and long-bodied small letters, so the text feels approachable.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-noto-sans-lisu: Pencil-line consistency, stretched wide: Warnes draws bold, expressive letters with tapered ink strokes that stop short of touching. Noto Sans Lisu stays quiet underneath, with wide s curves and tight ascenders.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-noto-sans-lydian: Warnes draws round letters whose rims match the stems. What stands out is how Noto Sans Lydian keeps capitals barely taller than lowercase, giving the bold, stretched heading a soft-spoken companion.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-noto-sans-mahajani: Noto Sans Mahajani reads modern and businesslike, its lowercase standing high against the capitals and each e opening like a funnel. Warnes tops it with neon-glass tube strokes, bold and stretched out.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-noto-sans-mayan-numeral: Noto Sans Mayan Numerals has long-bodied small letters and a gaping c. Warnes, drawn with a ruler-constant line and stretched tracking, looks best given room at a large size above it.
